limitations: No classification by geometric isomorphism, Newton polygon, Ekedahl–Oort type or automorphism group is claimed. The smooth rank-zero curve is not claimed irreducible. The theorem and verifiers have not been audited externally.
scientific_integrity: The statement is over an algebraic closure of characteristic three; the parameter domain is the explicitly defined quintic-discriminant complement. Standard Cartier and stable-Frobenius facts are used, with an exact block proof and distinct small-field computations.
title: A smooth rank-zero curve inside a three-parameter genus-five Hasse stratum
